name: vendor/premium-addon-starter
description: Premium add-on for a free core plugin, licensed and updated through WP License Captain.

scripts-descriptions.test: Unit tests with WordPress stubs. Set WPLC_SERVER_DIR to a wp-license checkout to also run the sync tests.
scripts-descriptions.client:vendor: Copy LicenseClient from the license server (WPLC_SERVER_DIR or --source=…) under this add-on's namespace.
scripts-descriptions.client:check: Fail when the vendored LicenseClient differs from the license server copy.
scripts-descriptions.fixtures: Regenerate the signed test fixtures with the license server's own code (needs WPLC_SERVER_DIR).
scripts-descriptions.release: Build dist/<slug>-<version>.zip and its .sha256 (optionally a release manifest).
